exposure: Number of children in the family
outcome: Exclusive breastfeeding at 40 days and 6 months
cohort: 1005 children aged five years or younger and their mothers in Lebanon
finding: Higher socio-economic status, as reflected by car ownership, and C-section delivery were associated with lower odds of exclusive breastfeeding across the first 6 months in Lebanon.
mod_finding: Children delivered via Caesarian section had lower odds of exclusive breastfeeding for 40 days and at 6 months.
